# Conversion Tracking Guide

## What is Conversion Tracking?

Conversion tracking measures valuable actions such as purchases, leads, phone calls, and form submissions.

## Common Conversions

- Form Submission
- Phone Call
- Purchase
- WhatsApp Click
- Newsletter Signup

## Platforms

- Google Ads
- Meta Ads
- Google Analytics 4

## Best Practices

- Test every conversion event.
- Use Google Tag Manager.
- Verify tracking before launching campaigns.
- Review conversion reports weekly.
